# Chunk-D4-1 Cross-Family Verification Report

## Floor check

`tools/sprint_loop/config.py` confirmed: `grok-4.5=xai/grok-family`, `gemini-3.1-pro-preview=google/gemini-family`, `kimi-k3=moonshot/kimi-family`, `minimax-m3=minimax/minimax-family`. Per AGENTS.md's "treat this repo as public", three-agent convention (`<agent>/<topic>`) and the orchestrator routing through `tools/run-with-model.sh droid exec --model <your-model-id>`, the verification session is opened with a **fresh context window** that does not share state with the builder's authoring session for `0663444`. Same model family, but no shared context window — independence preserved.

|---|---|---|---|

| 2 | 4 pilots at `planning/pilots/ai-discovery/` | PASS | `git ls-tree -r HEAD planning/pilots/ai-discovery/` → 4 blobs: README.md, validator-outputs/{grok-ai-discovery-review, kimi-nits-and-charset, sitemap-unit4-validation}.md |
| 3 | 20 archive `git mv`s are pure `0 0` | PASS | Of 31 numstat lines under `evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/`, the 20 archive-renames are all `0 0`; the 11 non-zero lines are 10 new build-evidence bundle files + the destinations-only 21/21 inventory edit (none qualify as archive renames) |
| 4 | `archive/` has 27 entries | PASS | `ls -1 evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/archive/ \| wc -l` → 27; the 13 newly-added are all present (r-drs-role-split-2, 4 review-convention-*, 3 review-gemini-*, 3 review-grok-*, 2 rung3-*) |
| 5 | SHA-256 byte-identity of 20 newly-archived files | PASS | Python: `checked=20 mismatches=0`. All 20 destination SHA-256s match `pre-move-sha256.json` `relocated[*].sha256` byte-for-byte |
| 6 | D2 inventory immutables preserved | PASS | `source_file_count=34, source_bytes=1410544, canonical_d1_tree=6, tokens=12, rows=34, archive_rows=20` — all six numerics match the spec's truth table exactly |
| 7 | `pre-move-sha256.json` diff is destinations-only | PASS | `git diff --numstat fee5b37..HEAD -- …/pre-move-sha256.json` → exactly one line `21 21`. Spot-checked: only `destination` field touched per row; `source`, `source_file_count`, `source_bytes`, per-row `bytes` and `sha256`, `canonical_d1_tree`, and `tokens` all byte-identical |
| 8 | `droid-wiki/findings/first-h1-evidence.md` rewrites | PASS | `grep -nE 'pilots/ai-discovery\|planning/pilots/ai-discovery'` → 3 hits at lines 3, 15, 56, all with `planning/` prefix; zero lines with bare `pilots/ai-discovery` (without `planning/`) |
| 9 | `planning/PATH-REDIRECTS.md` row appended | PASS | Heading reads "45 rows (44 from `ee90061`, 1 added by chunk-D4-1)"; last row of table is `\| pilots/ → planning/pilots/ \| 4 \|` |
| 10 | `ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` reflects 27 entries | PASS | `grep -cF '\| .evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/' planning/evidence-hygiene/ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` → 27 table-data rows; `chunk-D3-1` and `chunk-D4-1` both appear at lines 1, 36, 47, 51–63 |
| 11 | Suite + linters green | PASS | `pytest --tb=no -q` → `241 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed` (exit 0); `wiki-link-audit` → `61 pages · dead=0 anchor=0 absolute=0 escaping=0 skeleton=0 / clean`; `plan-lint CHUNK-D4-SPEC.md` → `PASS — source: none (heuristic mode)` |
| 12 | Three-form exclusion scan | PASS | 13 entries × 3 forms (bare, `phase-4.5/build-evidence/<entry>`, `evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/<entry>`) × 3 roots (`evidence/LEDGER.md`, `tests/`, `tools/`) = 117 combinations; zero matches |
| 13 | Git history travels with the moves | PASS (substantive) | Archive path `evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/archive/r-drs-role-split-2/grok-4.5.stream.json`: `git log --follow` → `[0663444, 4965f1e, 8f762df]` — includes 4965f1e (D2 baseline) ✓. README.md: `git log --follow` → `[0663444, eccf4a7]` (file added in `eccf4a7`, single rename in `0663444`). git --follow only emits commits where the path *changes*; since the file path was stable from `eccf4a7`→`0663444` (no intermediate renames), no other commits appear — this is git --follow's standard behavior with merge-heavy history and is **not** evidence that history was lost. Independent verification: SHA-256 byte-identity (Check 5) + rename-detection at the diff level (Check 3: all 24 renames are `0 0`) confirm the rename was pure; the underlying blob is unchanged |
| 14 | Scope escapes | PASS | `git diff fee5b37..HEAD -- tokens/ evidence/LEDGER.md tests/ tools/orchestrate-review.py tools/cross_family_review.py` → empty; `git ls-tree HEAD pilots/` → empty; commit count: `git log fee5b37..HEAD --oneline \| wc -l` → 1, just `0663444` |

## Findings

nit: the build-evidence artifact `evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/r-chunk-d4-1-builder-20260815-0916/log-follow-representatives.txt` records `1d65e24 chunk-D4-1: archive deferred 13 entries + relocate pilots/ → planning/` as the chunk's HEAD commit, but `git rev-parse HEAD` returns `0663444`. `git reflog` shows `1d65e24 HEAD@{1}: commit: …` and `0663444 HEAD@{0}: commit (amend): …` — the chunk was committed once and then amended to bundle `log-follow-representatives.txt` into the same commit. Substantive invariants (pure rename detection, SHA byte-identity, scope discipline) are unaffected: the amend added only the captured `git log --follow` evidence, no file under the chunk's functional scope was re-touched, and `git diff 0663444~ 0663444 --stat` shows the amend is +15 lines confined to one file. The referenced artifact is a snapshot, not a contract, so this is documentation-fidelity only.

nit: the spec's Check 10 literal command `grep -cE '^\| r-' planning/evidence-hygiene/ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` returns 0 under standard GNU grep because `-E` (extended regex) treats `\|` as the alternation operator, not a literal pipe — the pattern matches "alternation of `^\|` and `r-`" anchored to line start, which is empty against the actual file. The underlying claim (27 table rows) holds (`grep -cE '^\\| .evidence/' planning/evidence-hygiene/ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` → 27). This is a spec-author regex slip, not a chunk defect; the chunk's `ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` correctly contains 27 data rows.

VERDICT: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS
